build_dataset_builder: build a tensorflow dataset builder for the covid19 epidemiological database with demographics and health covariates
create_dataset_info: create dataset metadata with features for covid19 including confirmed cases, vaccinations, and government response indices
generate_dataset_examples: generate examples from the aggregated covid19 csv archive using pandas and apache beam for parallel processing
download_dataset_archive: download the covid19 open data aggregated csv archive from google cloud storage for dataset generation
cast_column_features: cast column values according to feature dtype to ensure string and float types match the dataset schema
